title: tc-context-tray
description: What the model can see, as chips with their token weight: remove (undoable), pin, and the total against the window.

heading.description: The heading, and the group's name

limit.description: Size of the context window in tokens (0: no meter, only the total)

reserved.description: Tokens already in the window besides these items – system prompt, tools, the conversation

warnAt.description: Share of the limit from which the tray warns (0–1)

undoTimeout.description: How long Undo stays after a removal, in ms (0: no undo)

emptyText.description: What the tray says with no items

tokens.description: Tokens this item takes in the window

kind.description: "file", "mention", "source" – or your own (it picks the icon and the meter colour)

pinned.description: Kept in context when the conversation is compacted

hint.description: Shown as the chip's tooltip, e.g. a path or a URL
